note: Starting lists, not complete and not legal advice. Used by tools/validate_scorecard.py and tools/bias_check.py. Add your own terms. Matching is by whole word or phrase, ignoring case.

gendered.man hours: Use person hours or work hours.
gendered.man-hours: Use person hours or work hours.
gendered.rockstar: Say what the person will do instead.
gendered.dominant: Describe the behaviour you need, such as leads a meeting.
gendered.aggressive: Say what you need, such as persistent follow up.
gendered.assertive: Say what you need, such as says no clearly and gives reasons.
gendered.manly: Remove, the job does not need it.
gendered.ladylike: Remove, the job does not need it.

age_coded.young: Remove. Describe the skill or energy level the work needs, not an age.
age_coded.youthful: Remove. Describe the work, not an age feel.
age_coded.younger: Remove. Age is not a job requirement.
age_coded.recent graduate: Say entry level or no experience needed instead.
age_coded.recent graduates: Say entry level or no experience needed instead.
age_coded.fresh graduate: Say entry level or no experience needed instead.
age_coded.digital native: Say which tools the person must already use, by name.
age_coded.digital natives: Say which tools the person must already use, by name.
age_coded.energetic: Say what the pace of the work is, such as 30 calls a day.
age_coded.high energy: Say what the pace of the work is, such as 30 calls a day.
age_coded.mature: Remove. Say the judgement you need, such as handles upset customers calmly.
age_coded.seasoned: Say the experience you need in plain terms, such as 3 years in support.
age_coded.overqualified: Remove. Decide on the scorecard, not on a guess about the person.
age_coded.old school: Remove. Describe the method you need.
age_coded.up and coming: Remove. Describe the level of the role.
age_coded.fresh blood: Remove. Describe the skills you need.

origin_coded.native speaker: Say the language level the job needs, such as writes clear English at C1, and why.
origin_coded.native english: Say the language level the job needs, and why.
origin_coded.native-level: Say the language level the job needs, and why.
origin_coded.mother tongue: Say the language level the job needs, and why.
origin_coded.accent free: Remove. Clear communication is tested in the work sample, not by accent.
origin_coded.no accent: Remove. Clear communication is tested in the work sample, not by accent.
origin_coded.english only: Say which language the work is done in and the level needed.
origin_coded.local candidates only: Say the location or time zone the work needs, and why.
origin_coded.citizens only: Say the work authorization the job needs, in neutral words.
origin_coded.must be a citizen: Say the work authorization the job needs, in neutral words.
origin_coded.ivy league: Say the skills you need, not the school.
origin_coded.prestigious university: Say the skills you need, not the school.
origin_coded.top university: Say the skills you need, not the school.

culture_fit.culture fit: Replace with specific working style needs, such as writes updates in the team channel daily.
culture_fit.cultural fit: Replace with specific working style needs, such as writes updates in the team channel daily.
culture_fit.fit in with: Say how the person must work with others, such as shares notes the same day.
culture_fit.work hard play hard: Remove. Describe the real hours and pace.
culture_fit.like family: Remove. It can push out people with other commitments. Describe the team plainly.

hype.ninja: Say the actual job title and skills.
hype.rockstar: Say the actual job title and skills.
hype.guru: Say the actual job title and skills.
hype.wizard: Say the actual job title and skills.
hype.superstar: Say the actual job title and skills.
hype.10x: Say the results you expect in numbers.
hype.unicorn: Say the real list of needs, split into must have and nice to have.
hype.hustler: Say the pace and hours of the work.
hype.thick skin: Say what is hard about the job, such as handling 20 refusals a week.
hype.self starter: Say what the person must do alone, such as plans their own week.

unlawful_asks.how old are you: Do not ask age. Ask only if the person is allowed to work, if the law requires it.
unlawful_asks.date of birth: Do not ask for date of birth before an offer. Collect it only if the law needs it, later.
unlawful_asks.are you married: Do not ask about marital status.
unlawful_asks.marital status: Do not ask about marital status.
unlawful_asks.do you have children: Do not ask about children or plans for them.
unlawful_asks.plan to have children: Do not ask about children or plans for them.
unlawful_asks.where were you born: Do not ask about birthplace. Ask if the person may work in the country.
unlawful_asks.what country are you from: Do not ask about origin. Ask if the person may work in the country.
unlawful_asks.maiden name: Do not ask for a maiden name.
unlawful_asks.do you have a disability: Do not ask about disability. Ask whether the person can do the listed tasks, with or without changes.
unlawful_asks.health condition: Do not ask about health. Ask whether the person can do the listed tasks.
unlawful_asks.send a photo: Do not ask for a photo. It adds bias and no job information.
unlawful_asks.attach a photo: Do not ask for a photo. It adds bias and no job information.
unlawful_asks.attach your photo: Do not ask for a photo. It adds bias and no job information.
unlawful_asks.photo of yourself: Do not ask for a photo. It adds bias and no job information.
unlawful_asks.salary history: Some places ban questions about past pay. Ask for expected pay instead, and check your local law.
unlawful_asks.current salary: Some places ban questions about past pay. Ask for expected pay instead, and check your local law.
unlawful_asks.previous salary: Some places ban questions about past pay. Ask for expected pay instead, and check your local law.
unlawful_asks.sexual orientation: Do not ask about sexual orientation.

inflated_terms.expert in everything: Split the list into must have and nice to have.
inflated_terms.must have all of the following: Keep only what the person needs on day one.
